title: What Will You Learn This Autumn at Stanford Online?
source_subject: What Will You Learn This Autumn at Stanford Online?
description: Enroll in a Stanford Online Graduate Course this Autumn Your search for knowledge growth ends here. Our graduate autumn quarter enrollment is now open, and new courses have just been added. Whether you want to learn about AI, robotics, or computer programming, Stanford Online is here to help you advance your education and expand your skill set. Are you ready to fuel your quest for learning? Here’s what you need to know: You must complete a short application . You can start any quarter. Tuition is $1,622.00 per unit. Enrollment closes September 6, and courses begin the week of September 22. View important autumn quarter dates on our Academic Calendar. Choose Your Online Course for Autumn Quarter >> Know before you enroll! Explore our courses firsthand. Some of our lectures are available on our YouTube channel . Take the Same Courses as Students on Campus Choose from courses in engineering, computer science, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, data science, business and management, health and medicine, and more. Watch recordings or live streams of lectures Join online office hours, complete homework, and take exams remotely Earn a Stanford University transcript and academic credit for every course you complete Complete a graduate certificate in as little as 1 year Apply up to 18 credits to an applicable master’s degree (if admitted) Compare our graduate credentials Featured Graduate Certificate Foundations in Computer Science Graduate Certificate Build the mathematical and computational thinking that underlies every area of computer science. In this certificate program, you'll work through the core theory that shapes how software is designed and reasoned about — logic, proof techniques, combinatorics, algorithm analysis, and discrete structures like sets, relations, trees, and finite automata. From there, you'll explore programming paradigms and the principles of object-oriented design, building the foundation for more advanced study in computing. Tuition: $29,196.00 - $32,440.00 Stanford Academic Units: 18-20 Learn More and Enroll >> Biomedical Data Science Graduate Certificate Build graduate-level expertise in bio- and clinical informatics, exploring well beyond what's covered at the undergraduate level. Our Biomedical Data Science Graduate Certificate focuses on developing new quantitative and computational approaches to some of the toughest problems spanning biology and medicine. Through coursework spanning genomic research to emerging applications in basic biology, you'll gain a deep understanding of the methods used to make sense of massive biological datasets. Tuition: $16,220.00 - $17,842.00 Stanford Academic Units: 9-10 Learn More and Enroll >> Featured Graduate Courses Programming Abstractions (CS106B) Gain valuable exposure to advanced computer programming and abstraction techniques. Become knowledgeable about the many implementation methods used to build complicated, dynamic data structures. Harness powerful tools for understanding how the representation and efficiency of data can influence how effectively we can store it. Tuition: $8,110.00 Stanford Academic Units: 5 Learn More and Enroll >> Fundamentals of Data Science: Prediction, Inference, Causality (MS&E226) This course explores the difference between "small" data and big data and provides an introduction to applied data analysis, with an emphasis on a conceptual framework for thinking about data from both statistical and machine learning perspectives. Tuition: $4,866.00 Stanford Academic Units: 3 Learn More and Enroll >> Decision Making Under Uncertainty (AA228) This course is designed to increase awareness and appreciation for why uncertainty matters, particularly for aerospace applications. It introduces decision making under uncertainty from a computational perspective and provides an overview of the necessary tools for building autonomous and decision-support systems. Following an introduction to probabilistic models and decision theory, the course will cover computational methods for solving decision problems with stochastic dynamics, model uncertainty, and imperfect state information. Tuition: $4,866.00 - $6,488.00 Stanford Academic Units: 3-4 Learn More and Enroll >> Fundamentals of Drug Discovery (TRAM223A) Explore the fundamental processes and methodologies of drug discovery in this comprehensive course designed for aspiring pharmaceutical researchers and industry professionals. Tuition: $4,866.00 Stanford Academic Units: 3 Learn More and Enroll >> Get Personalized Course Recommendations Receive an email with Stanford graduate courses that match your interests. Ready?
